title: Opening the hoard generates real loot and a journal entry

llm_context.canon: The iron-bound chest is unlocked and open. It holds the crypt keeper's hoard — appropriate treasure for a CR 2 cache.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I lift the chest's lid and see what's inside.

actions.text: The lid groans open on a glint of old coin. Beneath a rotted purse, something wrapped in oilcloth waits to be unrolled.
